description: Agent Hiring: submit a hiring brief or role specification with the job record it answers: the brief with the job it cites, the role, each item of work, each deliverable, the currency, the budget and the days work starts and is due; the job record with its reference, role, work, deliverables, currency, budget and days. The signed report gives the brief and the job record, the role on each side read as matching or differing, the job’s work and deliverables matched to the brief’s with the items dropped and added, the budget against the job budget, and the start and due days against the job’s, and counts them, and names a divergent brief: a role unlike the job record, an item of work or a deliverable the job lists and the brief leaves out, a budget above the job record, a due day later than the job record and a due day before the start; then another cited job, work or deliverables the job record does not list, a lower budget, an earlier due day and another start day, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No role, no work or deliverables on either side, no budget or no due day leaves the brief unverified. Roles read with their common short forms spelled out, so Sr. and Senior read as one, and work and deliverables by their words. This reads a written brief against the job record before anything is committed: the intent job kit, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job, wever_job-brief, wever_job-cost-brief, wever_job-receipt-pack and wever_job-handoff-pack, is the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, with wever_job-brief drafting a brief from a job description, and the Agent Onboarding checks such as wever_onboarding-credential-check and wever_onboarding-identity-check read the records for bringing an already chosen party into a system, while the brief check reads the pre-commitment brief for choosing and engaging against the job it answers. Verdict hire_brief_divergent, hire_brief_partial, hire_brief_unverified or hire_brief_consistent. POST /api/hire-brief-check. Reads the hiring paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no judgment of whether a candidate is good, qualified in substance or worth hiring, no background check, no contact with referees or issuers, no verification with outside sources and no employment-law advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Hiring reads supplied hiring paperwork for consistency between documents: a hiring brief, a credential record, a portfolio or past-work record, a reference, a rate quote, an engagement contract, an availability commitment and a payment setup. Beside it, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job and the other tools of the intent job kit are the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, and wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork before anything is committed; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-hiring-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-hiring/.
